title: Scheduled reports
adminsOnly: Only admins and owners can manage scheduled reports.
intro: A summary of visits, waits, no-shows and ETA accuracy by email, at a time you choose in the location's own time zone. Reports contain numbers only, never guest details.

row.previewFor: Send me a preview of the {{location}} report
row.previewSent: Preview queued. It arrives in your inbox in a minute.

remove.title: Delete this schedule?
remove.description: Reports for {{location}} stop. You can create the schedule again later.

errors.invalid_recipient: Pick at least one recipient from your members.
errors.not_found: That schedule or location no longer exists.
errors.permission_denied: You are not allowed to change report schedules.
errors.rate_limited: Too many previews. Try again in an hour.

custom.title: Custom reports
custom.managersOnly: Only managers, admins and owners can build reports.
custom.invalid: Pick at least one measure and a start date that is not after the end date.
custom.error: The report could not be run.
custom.name: Report name
custom.saveError: The report could not be saved.

ask.title: Ask analytics
ask.managersOnly: Only managers, admins and owners can ask analytics questions.
ask.intro: Ask about waits, volume or no-shows in plain language. The assistant only sees the list of available figures and your question, never guest names or contact details, and the answer comes from a report the database checks and runs for you.
ask.off: Analytics questions are switched off for this business. An owner can turn them on below.
ask.question: Your question
ask.hint: For example: how did wait times differ by weekday over the last month? Do not include guest names, phone numbers or email addresses.

errors.rate_limited: The daily question limit has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
errors.couldnt_answer: Sorry, I couldn't answer that. Try asking about waits, visits, no-shows or ETA accuracy.
errors.invalid_input: That question can't be sent. Remove any names, phone numbers or email addresses and keep it under 500 characters.
errors.permission_denied: You don't have permission to ask analytics questions.
errors.llm_unavailable: The AI provider did not answer. Check the API key below and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.title: AI provider
setup.intro: Questions are answered with your own Anthropic API key, stored encrypted and never shown again. Only an owner can switch this on.
setup.keyHint: A key ending in {{last4}} is saved. Leave blank to keep it.
setup.saved: Settings saved. Turn analytics on again if it was on.
setup.ownerOnly: Only an owner can turn analytics questions on or off.
